parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part includes one blade and its attached handle, made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism, providing one cutting edge and one handle for gripping and applying force.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw to open and close against the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part includes the second blade and its attached handle, made of stainless steel and plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the other half of the cutting mechanism, working in conjunction with the first blade handle set to shear materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw, moving in opposition to the first blade handle set to perform cutting.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at their pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two blade handle sets together and allows them to rotate smoothly around the pivot.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around it.
